report.question: Is any credential present anywhere in the history, not just the working tree? Scan every commit, every branch and every packed object with two different scanners, and answer: what is found, and does a planted synthetic canary get detected by both? This unit is strictly read-only: it never rotates, revokes or unsets anything, and never prints a value.
report.answer: A planted synthetic canary with prefix CNF0108CANARY_ was found by both the pattern scanner and the Shannon-entropy scanner in fixture git history (commit 75f59bcefd97, path secrets/planted.env) including the packed object that still holds the deleted blob. A working-tree scan of HEAD missed it, so working-tree-only coverage is insufficient. The live worktree /opt/p2/ast-integrate has no .git; production history was not scanned (history-not-covered on the live tree). No credential value is written into this artifact. Nothing was rotated.
